name: csv_summary
description: Print per-column summary statistics (count, mean, std, min, quartiles, max for numerics; value counts for non-numerics) for a CSV file. A thin wrapper around pandas DataFrame.describe() for a single file path. Use instead of hand-rolling summarize loops.
command_template: python3 -c "import pandas as pd, sys; df=pd.read_csv('{csv_path}'); print(df.describe(include='all').to_string()); print('---nullable counts---'); print(df.isnull().sum().to_string())"
parameters_json: [{"name": "csv_path", "type": "string", "description": "Path to the CSV file to summarize.", "required": true}]
